cond_0001.intro: Provide leadership and guidance to the electronics design team and electronics suppliers on new development programs for aircraft electronics equipment, from inception to certification, and transfer to production. Drive skill development within the EE team and routinely mentors others in technical area of expertise. Interface with cross-functional development team, program management and customers to ensure overall technical compliance of the product and serves as an expert resource to other engineers. Define electronics architecture based on required functionality, safety and compliance with certification regulations. Technical responsibilities include circuit design, analysis, integration, debugging, establishing test methods and test equipment design. Responsible for quality of design, in terms of cost, performance, DFM, assembly and test. Review project deliverables to ensure accuracy and adherence to schedules and production commitments. Performs design & cost tradeoff studies. Directs product improvement and cost reduction initiatives by responding to internal and external customer requests. Write procurement specifications, conduct vendor design reviews and vendor liaison. Assist purchasing and quality assurance departments in surveys, vendor selections, product evaluation, production support, and component obsolescence issues. Prepare and present technical information for TIM's, PDR's, CDR's etc. Support proposal bids and risk assessment and mitigation for electronic development activities.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Industrial Technology from an accredited institution.
7+ Years of experience in electrical/electronic engineering and design.

Must be able to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now and within the future.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced Technical Degree.
Experience with fuel systems, fuel gauging, low power electronics and/or capacitance measurement.
Project management experience including schedule, technical risk and cost.
Experience with FAA certification.

Assist purchasing and quality assurance departments in surveys, vendor selections, product evaluation, production support, and component obsolescence issues. Prepare and document technical information for TIMs, PDRs, CDRs, etc., and share with relevant stakeholders. Support proposal bids and risk assessment and mitigation for electronic development activities.
cond_0196.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Industrial Technology from an accredited institution.
Seven (7)+ years of experience in electrical/electronic engineering and design.

All applicants must be U.S. Persons within the meaning of ITAR. ITAR defines a U.S. Person as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee.
Must be able to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now and within the future.
Advanced Technical Degree preferred.
Experience with fuel systems, fuel gauging, low power electronics and/or capacitance measurement.
Project management experience including schedule, technical risk, and cost.
Experience with FAA certification.

Coordinate with cross-functional development teams, program management, and customers to help ensure overall technical compliance of the product, and serve as a shared expert resource for other engineers. Collaborate on defining electronics architecture based on required functionality, safety, and compliance with certification regulations. Technical responsibilities include circuit design, analysis, integration, debugging, establishing test methods, and test equipment design. Share accountability for quality of design in terms of cost, performance, DFM, assembly, and test. Review project deliverables together to ensure accuracy and adherence to schedules and production commitments. Assist with design and cost tradeoff studies. Support product improvement and cost reduction initiatives by working with internal and external customers on their requests. Help write procurement specifications, participate in vendor design reviews, and coordinate vendor liaison activities. Work with purchasing and quality assurance departments on surveys, vendor selections, product evaluation, production support, and component obsolescence issues. Prepare and present technical information for TIMs, PDRs, CDRs, etc. Support proposal bids and coordinate risk assessment and mitigation for electronic development activities.
cond_0459.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Industrial Technology from an accredited institution.
7+ Years of experience in electrical/electronic engineering and design.
This position requires use of information or access to hardware which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. Persons within the meaning of ITAR. ITAR defines a U.S. Person as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee.
Must be able to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now and within the future.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced Technical Degree.
Experience with fuel systems, fuel gauging, low power electronics, and/or capacitance measurement.
Project management experience including schedule, technical risk, and cost.
Experience with FAA certification.

cond_0495.intro: We are looking for a Sustenance Engineer to join our team.
cond_0495.responsibilities: Work alongside the electronics design team and electronics suppliers on new development programs for aircraft electronics equipment, from inception to certification, and transfer to production. Support skill development within the EE team and regularly help others grow in technical areas. Coordinate with cross-functional development teams, program management, and customers to help ensure overall technical compliance of the product, and serve as a shared expert resource for other engineers. Collaborate on defining electronics architecture based on required functionality, safety, and compliance with certification regulations. Technical responsibilities include circuit design, analysis, integration, debugging, establishing test methods, and test equipment design. Share accountability for quality of design in terms of cost, performance, DFM, assembly, and test. Review project deliverables together to ensure accuracy and adherence to schedules and production commitments. Assist with design and cost tradeoff studies. Support product improvement and cost reduction initiatives by working with internal and external customers on their requests. Help write procurement specifications, participate in vendor design reviews, and coordinate vendor liaison activities. Work with purchasing and quality assurance departments on surveys, vendor selections, product evaluation, production support, and component obsolescence issues. Prepare and present technical information for TIMs, PDRs, CDRs, etc. Support proposal bids and coordinate risk assessment and mitigation for electronic development activities.
cond_0495.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Industrial Technology from an accredited institution.
7+ Years of experience in electrical/electronic engineering and design.
This position requires use of information or access to hardware which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. Persons within the meaning of ITAR. ITAR defines a U.S. Person as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee.
Must be able to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now and within the future.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced Technical Degree.
Experience with fuel systems, fuel gauging, low power electronics, and/or capacitance measurement.
Project management experience including schedule, technical risk, and cost.
Experience with FAA certification.
